resources.string: Select all the screenshots of the lobby after all players have joined. Crop tightly to the lobby area and exclude any extra text, overlays, or unrelated content. Screenshots are stored only on this device; clearing app data or uninstalling PointIQ removes the locally stored copies.

Select all the screenshots showing the final match results. Crop tightly to the results area and exclude any extra text, overlays, or unrelated content. Screenshots are stored only on this device; clearing app data or uninstalling PointIQ removes the locally stored copies.
Add screenshots after all players have joined. Make sure all player names and team slots are clearly visible.
Add screenshots showing the complete final results, including the last two teams.
If auto-crop fails or cuts off important details, manually adjust the crop. Keep only the relevant lobby or result area, without chat, overlays, or unrelated content.
Tap any screenshot to replace, remove, or edit its crop.
Reuse a saved lobby only when the team and player details remain accurate. Otherwise, upload new screenshots.
Check all team names, positions, kills, and team slots before finalizing.
You can manually edit incorrect positions, kills, and team slots.
Use the three-dot menu beside a result to add missing teams, delete incorrect teams, or apply bonuses and penalties.
Check the "Fix before finalizing" messages and correct the highlighted issues.
Use Clear Result if you want to remove the calculated results and calculate again.
Verify everything before finalizing. Finalized results become read-only in the normal review screen.
